description: The user's real work-in-progress UNROM-512 (mapper 30) homebrew. This is the regression guard for the mapper-30 + unofficial-6502-opcode work that landed on 2026-09-02: Mapper30.cs, the self-flashing battery variant, and the unofficial opcodes added to CPU_FIX. The ROM lives on the Desktop, not in the repo, so on any other machine these cases SKIP rather than fail.

cases.description: Boot with no input at all. Guards that the mapper-30 cartridge still loads, banks and renders its title screen.

The real regression guard for the unofficial-opcode work. Presses Start twice (frames 120 and 240) to get past the title screen into code that the boot case never reaches. Its framebuffer must differ from mapper30-boot-fix - it does (3 distinct colours on the title screen, 6 after Start) - so a golden match here proves input was delivered AND the post-title code path executed to the same pixels.
Same input script run to 900 frames. Confirms the post-Start screen is stable rather than mid-transition at frame 600.

A DELIBERATELY-FAILING-EMULATOR case: this ROM crashes CPU_FMC on frame 0 with 'Bad opcode A7' (LAX zp), because the unofficial opcodes were only ever added to CPU_FIX. Expected exit code is 1 (crashed), not 0. It exists for two reasons: it proves mapper30-boot-fix's green is meaningful rather than vacuous, and it will go red the day someone adds unofficial opcodes to CPU_FMC - at which point updating this golden is the correct response.

expect.crashInfo: Bad opcode A7 at C176 PC=C177

cases.description: Save/load round trip on the mapper-30 cartridge. Mapper 30 is self-flashing (its battery variant writes back to PRG), so its state serialisation has more to get wrong than a plain UNROM.
